extraction.experiment: Raising the threshold γ = β/α by doubling β or by halving α gives the same epidemic peak I*/N ≈ 0.30, but the peak arrives about twice as late when α is cut, which is the paper's scaling result t*(2) = t*(1)/λ (Eq. 23).
extraction.reproduce: Doubling β (α unchanged) doubles γ, so the peak drops to I*/N ≈ 0.30 and arrives near day 41 (Table 1).
extraction.contrast: Halving α instead (β unchanged) gives the same γ, the same peak height and the same final size, but the peak comes about twice as late.
